title: Jets fans expect a big bounceback season from Geno Smith

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets fans expect a big bounceback season from Geno Smith
sources.description: The Jets did not need to pay much to reacquire quarterback Geno Smith in the offseason. Smith returned to New York in a trade involving a late round pick swap. The Jets also gave Geno a small salary bump. The hope is that the veteran quarterback can provide some stability at the most important position […]
